item.title: Clark County pet owners look to keep veterinary care affordable with pet insurance
item.description: With the rising cost of veterinary care squeezing already pinched household budgets, Clark County residents are increasingly signing up for pet insurance.

item.title: WDFW proposing changes for shellfish harvesting, asks for public input
item.description: The Washington Department of Fish & Wildlife has proposed rule changes for recreational clam, mussel, and oyster seasons, as well as increasing the size of harvestable cockles, and a reduction in the geoduck daily limit from three to one. They are requesting public comments on the possible changes.

item.title: How environmental enforcement has dropped under Trump
item.description: WASHINGTON — Federal enforcement of polluters slumped in the first year of the second Trump administration, a new analysis of government data by a nonprofit watchdog group has found.

item.title: 4A district wrestling: No rivalry, just family — Camas’ Jarrell brothers savor moment in 175-pound final
item.description: At Saturday’s 4A district wrestling championships at Prairie High School, Camas brothers Simon and Arthur Jarrell turned the 175-pound final into a family showdown, facing each other in a high-scoring and crowd-pleasing match that was less about rivalry and more about savoring the experience.

item.title: Gabriella Howard overcomes illness to become Union’s first all-around district gymnastics champ
item.description: A higher degree of difficulty didn’t faze Gabriella Howard. The Union senior’s tough routines weren’t her only challenge Saturday at the Class 4A District 4 Gymnastics Championships.

item.title: Anna Pena Molina of Mountain View wins 3A/2A gymnastics district title at wire
item.description: To say Anna Pena Molina saved her best for last wasn’t a figure of speech on Saturday. That’s because the all-around title at the Class 3A/2A District 4 Gymnastics Championships wasn’t decided until the last performance of the evening at VEGA Washougal.
